about: Which sources in sources.json need a sign-in, and whether a script can use them without an interactive browser. Kept by hand. tools/access.mjs prints it. Keys and tokens are never stored here; tokenEnv names the environment variable that would hold one.

sources.how: GET https://api.sketchfab.com/v3/models/{uid}/download with an Authorization header returns short-lived links (glTF, USDZ; the link expires in 300 s). Search is open and needs no token.
sources.limits: The docs say users of an app must be able to log in. Using your own token for your own use fits that. Downloads with no user login need a deal with Sketchfab. The sample uses an OAuth Bearer token; the Data API page names the personal API token as the other way. Which of the two the download endpoint accepts was not tested.

sources.how: The download is a web form: pick a format, press Download, and the page shows a temporary link to a zip file. No public API was found. The temporary link itself can be fetched by a script once the form has made it.
sources.limits: Terms of use not read. Scripted use of the form was not checked against the terms.
sources.verified: 2026-11-01, one download done by hand with the owner's yes; a web search found no API

sources.how: The one public API is the GrabCAD Print API. It drives printers and has no model library. The Community Library downloads only through the signed-in website.
sources.limits: Terms of service not read (https://grabcad.com/terms). On 2026-11-01 grabcad.com answered with a CloudFront 403 "Request blocked" in the built-in browser and in the owner's own desktop browser, so the site cannot be reached from this machine for now.
sources.verified: 2026-11-01, third-party profile (API Evangelist) and search results read; GrabCAD's own pages not read (blocked, 403)

sources.how: The Blender add-on signs in and keeps an API key from your profile. No public REST documentation for other programs was found.
sources.limits: Free and paid tiers. Whether a script outside Blender may use the key is not documented. Do not assume it.

sources.how: The API needs a key and a paid tier.
